name: coverage
cmd: mise exec -- uv run --extra dev pytest -q --cov=src --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=80

name: types
cmd: mise exec -- sh -c 'pyright --pythonpath "$(uv run --extra dev python -c "import sys; print(sys.executable)")"'

name: lint
cmd: mise exec -- uv run --extra dev ruff check src tests tools
